fixes.explanation: That's him. The LORD says He will deliver them to “…Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon…” (Jeremiah 29:21). The LORD also says Nebuchadnezzar will kill them before the exiles' very eyes, and I think that part is heavy. The LORD says it plainly, so we'll say it plainly too.

That's what the LORD says. “In your own name you have sent out letters…” (Jeremiah 29:25). Those letters went to all the people of Jerusalem, to the priest Zephaniah, and to all the priests. Shemaiah sent them in his own name, and I'd say that matters a lot.
